inputs.original_text: President Luis Abinader continued his high-level agenda in France this week, focusing on the Dominican Republic’s integration into global transparency standards. On 25 March 2026 in Paris, Foreign Minister Roberto Álvarez and OECD Secretary-General Mathias Cormann signed a Memorandum of Understanding to formalize a partnership to design the country’s first National Integrity and Anti-Corruption Strategy, with President Abinader witnessing the signing. The agreement aims to align the Dominican…
